thread:
ava: quick proposal 1mdash; introduce "bounded sticky overrides" for runtime config. short-lived, affinity-bound overrides with TTL + leak protection. want fast feedback before i write the RFC.

sam: interesting. affinity options? session/tenant/user? how would this interact with prefix cache?

ava: yes: affinity = session|tenant|user. apply sticky after route selection but before KV/prefix cache so cached prefixes respect stickies for TTL.

marta: product ask 1mdash; console must list active stickies, creator, TTL, revoke button, and show cap usage. non-technical PMs need clear TTL and owner info.

jin: ops concern: routing table growth if many session stickies. propose per-tenant cap (default 200) with warning at 150; eviction oldest-first or LRU.

ava: agreed. also global hard-max ttl (24h) to avoid runaway experiments. owner can request ops approval for longer.

sam: telemetry: emit sticky.override.created/applied/evicted/leak_detected. include labels affinity, scope_id, creator, mode(shadow/active). default telemetry_sample_rate=0.01.

marta: preview idea 1mdash; console runs shadow dry-run over recent 10m to estimate qps% and cost delta before activation. helpful for PMs.

jin: shadow mode doable: evaluation-only path + diff report. ops-bot can schedule replay. keep shadow data TTL short.

ops-bot: dry-run summary for stky-185111-01 1mdash; 10m window, affected 0.5% requests, mean latency +1.8ms, cost +0.7%.

sam: API sketch:
POST /v1/runtime/overrides
{ "affinity":"tenant", "selector":"org-123", "delta":{"route.default.model":"ggml-3-small"}, "mode":"shadow|active", "ttl_seconds":3600, "max_coverage_percent":5, "eviction_policy":"oldest|lru", "telemetry_sample_rate":0.01, "reason":"string", "owner_contact":"name@redwood.com" }

ava: edge cases: if target route is deleted mark sticky as orphaned and auto-expire (5m). console should surface orphaned stickies for rebind/revoke.

jin: implementation notes: sticky map sharded by tenant hash; fast-path lookup (tenant, session); TTL eviction via timer wheel; cap per-shard; atomic local counters with eventual aggregator.

marta: i'll mock console list + revoke + preview UI. sam, can you own telemetry schema? jin, ops review infra?

sam: will take telemetry.

jin: i'll review infra.

ava: thanks all. i'll draft RFC in 48h unless objections. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: note 1mdash; RFC draft queued: https://git.internal/r/redwood/rfcs/1260
